subject: Decision lanes & champion amplification — next steps and security loop
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@novusdata.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Decision lanes & champion amplification — next steps and security loop

Liam,

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we all have the same set of decision lanes and asks.

Recap (short):
- Primary use case: real-time document understanding + conversational customer support at 200 reqs/sec peak.
- Success metrics: reduce inference costs by ~40% and improve average resolution time by 30%.
- Deployment constraint: data residency + audit logs are required; must support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM).

Decision criteria (what Novus said mattered most):
1) Unit cost per token and predictability for 99th pct throughput
2) Latency/real-time behaviour (<= 150ms tail target)
3) Security/compliance (SOC2, audit logs, KMS integration)
4) Procurement/timing (target contract window July)

Stakeholders you called out:
- Priya Singh (Data Platform lead) — technical champion (we should arm her with a one-page tech + ROI brief)
- Marta Ruiz (CFO) — economic buyer / budget approver
- Procurement: procurement@novusdata.com (please confirm contact name)
- Security: security@novusdata.com (for the security tech-fit)

Proposed next steps:
1) Intro to Marta (CFO) so we can align on pricing and contract cadence.
2) Schedule a 60-minute security tech-fit with Priya + your security (scope: KMS, data flow, audit logs, SOC2 evidence).
3) Share a short mutual action plan (MAP) and a 1-page ROI that Priya can use internally.
4) Quick internal alignment at Redwood (Ben + Rishi) for pricing bands and an early-commit incentive.

I attached the discovery notes from today's call (novus_discovery_notes.pdf).

If you can confirm procurement contact and a couple windows for the security call next week, we'll get everything out in a single MAP and a champion-ready talk track.

Thanks —
Ava Chen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0104

Attachment: novus_discovery_notes.pdf

Ben / Rishi —

Thanks — below is a champion-ready talk track and suggested Priya-facing email she can use with Marta / procurement. Also calling out our answers to Liam's KMS / region questions so Priya has crisp responses.

(Quoted for context)
On Tue, 29 Jun 2027, Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@novusdata.com> wrote:
> Hi Ava —
> 
> Nice recap, thanks. Quick clarifications from our side:
> - Procurement lead: Ethan Park (procurement@novusdata.com) — looping him in. Target procurement window is around July 20 (internal approvals permitting).
> - Security group: security@novusdata.com (they asked for a short tech-fit to review data flows and KMS options).
> - Champion: Priya Singh will own the technical case internally and will need a one-page talk track + ROI.
> - Economic buyer: Marta Ruiz (CFO) — I've copied her on a separate intro in a follow-up; she'll want topline ROI and contract cadence options.

Champion talk track (Priya — simple bullets):
- What Redwood buys you: consistent <150ms tail latency at 200 reqs/sec via our continuous batching + KV cache, with transparent per-token economics so finance can forecast costs.
- Security/compliance engine: supports customer-managed KMS, SOC2-ready infra, full audit logs (retention configurable), and private deployment (VPC / on-prem) options for regulated data.
- Ops & rollout: model version pinning, canary rollouts, automatic fallback to compatible model variants to avoid downtime.

Suggested email Priya can send to Marta / Procurement:
"Marta / Ethan — Redwood has proposed an approach that materially reduces inference cost and meets our security requirements (KMS + audit logs). They provided a conservative ROI estimate showing ~40% lower unit cost and a 3–4 month payback. I'd like to run a short security tech-fit next week (30–60m) and get a procurement timeline so we can lock practical pricing. Happy to share the 1-page ROI and a MAP."

Answers to Liam's Qs: 
- KMS: Yes — Redwood supports customer-managed keys (we integrate with common KMS providers; HSM options available on Private deployments).
- Regions / residency: Hosted Redwood has us-west regions and a Private option for full on-prem/VPC (we'll include region-specific latencies in the MAP).

Pricing ask: proposing a 20% early-commit incentive if Novus signs a 12-month reserved capacity commitment before July 31. Rishi — can you confirm approval for a 20% early-commit discount (or propose an alternative band)?

Attaching the champion talk track for Priya (priya_champion_talktrack.pdf). I'm happy to draft the intro email to Marta once Rishi confirms the discount band and Ben confirms the final ROI numbers.

Thanks —
Ava Chen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
